experiment_name: OB-Centric AI Research on Real SMC/OB Trades
research_question: Can an AI filter improve the actual SMC/OB trades generated by the application, using the application's real entry, second-edge SL, TP and risk/leverage rules, while maintaining sufficient coverage and statistically significant improvement?

reproducibility.threshold_rule: argmax validation incremental expectancy subject to coverage>=15%, incremental>0 and accepted>rejected; relax floor to 10%; else 0.50R frozen default
reproducibility.sl_config: second edge of the Order Block

primary_selection_basis: max validation incremental expectancy among rule-eligible thresholds (OOS never used)

C4_minimum_ai_coverage.detail: AI coverage 38.38% of OOS SMC setups (floor 15.0%)

C5_bootstrap_ci_lower_bound_positive.detail: Incremental expectancy MBB 95% CI lower bound -0.0858R

C8_no_unacceptable_liquidation_risk.detail: 0 trades with estimated liquidation before SL
